policies.title: Lebanese ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Lebanon as Prior to Arrival, which it defines as obtaining a visa from a mission or consulate before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Lebanese ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Lebanese ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Lebanese visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a Lebanese ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Lebanese ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Lebanon in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring approval before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Lebanese ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country-document waiver.
The authorized visa must be granted before travel and approval may take up to 60 business days; applicants should confirm local filing procedure with their competent Panamanian consulate.
Passport validity, residence, special documents, work, transit and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Jordan's live official nationality table says Lebanese visitors obtain a visa on arrival; it does not establish visa-free admission.
